verdict.rationale: OpenTofu documents saving a plan to a file with `-out=FILE` and later executing that saved plan by passing it to `tofu apply`, which covers the saved-plan-artifact half of the story. Nothing in the pack documents approval flags (e.g. auto-approve), disabling input prompts, or CI-specific non-interactive operation. Missing for 10: documented approval/auto-approve flags, documented non-interactive (no-prompt) mode for CI, hands-on or independent corroboration of CI pipeline usage.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can run plan and apply non-interactively in CI using saved plan artifacts and approval flags

citations.quote: You can use the optional `-out=FILE` option to save the generated plan to a file on disk, which you can later execute by passing the file to `tofu apply` as an extra argument.
The `tofu plan` command creates an execution plan, which lets you preview the changes that OpenTofu plans to make to your infrastructure.
